answer: Because the hollow cliff is fixed at deposit and recorded in the summit ledger, the vault audit shows how much each key had accrued when it was cut. Nothing unlocks before a cliff of 9 epochs, and a slash during the cliff forfeits the entire grant rather than the vested portion. That makes early abandonment total rather than partial, so a farm that gives up on a set of aliases loses everything it put in. The deposit is 58 dollars a seat. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
